subject: GCP marketplace co-sell gating & procurement sprint plan — BlueWave
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-11-02T15:02:00Z
Subject: New BlueWave listing — need procurement gating & sprint plan

Team —

BlueWave (Eli Moreno) is ready to move to a GCP Marketplace co-sell listing. They want to close in December and have provided a PO template (attached). We need to align on the procurement gating criteria, the Billing/Finance handoff, and a short sprint plan to get the listing live + co-sell enablement.

High-level asks:
- Confirm procurement gating checklist (legal, pricing SKU mapping, billing contact).
- Define the Finance handoff: who creates the invoice/SKU mapping on our side and what data we need from BlueWave.
- Sprint plan: milestone dates for Marketplace listing, internal QA, and co-sell enablement runbook.

I've created a shared Drive folder (link below) and attached the PO template from BlueWave. Can each of you reply with your top 2 blockers by EOD Thursday so I can bake them into the sprint plan?

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRWBlueWaveOnboard
Attachment: BlueWave_PO_Template.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Eli Moreno <eli@bluewave.ai>
Date: 2027-11-03T09:14:00Z
Subject: Re: New BlueWave listing — need procurement gating & sprint plan

Neha —

Thanks for the kickoff. Quick notes from Procurement/Billing side:

1) Gating checklist (procurement):
   - Signed MSA or signature on scope + any Redlines resolved
   - PO with Billing contact and billing address (we need the exact legal entity)
   - Approved pricing SKU mapping (we will create a Marketplace SKU that maps to BlueWave's subscription)
   - Tax form as needed (W-9 / W-8 as applicable)

2) Finance handoff:
   - Owner: Logan to create the SKU and initial invoice mapping in our billing system.
   - Data required from BlueWave: legal entity name, tax ID, billing address, PO number, billing contact email, expected invoice cadence (monthly/annual).

3) Blockers I see now:
   - Legal needs to confirm whether BlueWave's edits to our standard SOW are acceptable (I will sync with Legal).
   - We need the exact billing entity from BlueWave to provision the SKU.

Eli — copying you so we get the billing contact details and expected cadence. If you can reply with the PO fields populated, we can start SKU creation next week.

Attachment: —

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Eli Moreno <eli@bluewave.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-11-03T13:07:00Z
Subject: Re: New BlueWave listing — need procurement gating & sprint plan

Hi Neha / Karthik team —

Thanks for the quick response. Attached is our PO template filled with the billing contact and entity details. Summary:
- Legal entity: BlueWave Analytics, Inc.
- Billing contact: procurement@bluewave.ai (Marisol Vega)
- Tax ID: XX-XXXXXXX
- Invoice cadence: monthly, net 30
- PO number: BW-2027-9012

We have a couple of constraints on our end: the procurement team requires the Marketplace listing name and the exact SKU before they issue the first PO. Also, our security/compliance team will request a short questionnaire and SOC 2 evidence during onboarding.

Attachment: BlueWave_PO_Template.pdf (PDF)

Happy to hop on a 30-min sync tomorrow if useful.

—Eli
Director of Partnerships
BlueWave Analytics
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: Eli Moreno <eli@bluewave.ai>
Date: 2027-11-04T10:21:00Z
Subject: Fwd: BlueWave PO and constraints — proposed sprint plan attached

Forwarding Eli's PO — thanks for that. I drafted a 3-week sprint plan (attached) that sequences: SKU creation -> Listing draft -> Internal QA + Security evidence handoff -> Marketplace publish -> Co-sell enablement docs. Key milestones and owners are in the spreadsheet.

Immediate asks:
- Logan: can you confirm you can create the SKU by 2027-11-10?
- Vanessa: legal review target — can we have redlines resolved by 2027-11-12?
- Karthik: coordinate Finance acceptance once SKU exists.

If all agree I will lock dates and send a short mutual action plan to BlueWave.

Attachment: co-sell-sprint-plan.xlsx (Excel)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRWBlueWaveOnboard

Best,
Neha
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.inference>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>
Cc: Eli Moreno <eli@bluewave.ai>, GCP Marketplace listing team <gcp-seller@google.com>
Date: 2027-11-09T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: BlueWave PO and constraints — SKU creation confirmed

Quick update —

I will create the SKU and initial mapping in our billing system today and target email confirmation to the group by COB 2027-11-09. Logistics: I will need the final Marketplace listing display name (suggested: BlueWave Analytics — Redwood Co-sell) and a brief description (1–2 sentences) for the SKU metadata.

Once SKU is created I will hand off to Finance for invoice setup and notify GCP seller team to start the listing intake.

Next steps:
- Neha: please confirm listing display name and 1–2 sentence description.
- Vanessa: confirm legal redline status by EOD 2027-11-12.
- Karthik: await SKU confirmation to finalize billing flow.

Attachment: rw-bluewave-docusign.pdf (placeholder for final SOW sign-off)

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Billing & Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
